sn38.1:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Sāriputto Magadhesu viharati Nāla kagāmake || || 2
sn38.1:1.2: Atha kho Jambukhādako paribbājako yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhim sammodi ||
sn38.1:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Jambukhādako paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || ||
sn38.1:2.3: Yo kho āvuso rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo
sn38.1:2.5: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti || ||
sn38.1:2.6: Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti || || 5
sn38.1:2.7: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti || ||
sn38.1:2.8: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn38.1:2.9: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammā ājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi ||
sn38.1:2.10: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti || || 6
sn38.1:2.11: Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya ||
